versions.changelog:
Initial release of markdown-to-html-converter.

- Converts Markdown files to HTML using conventions from tools like marked.js, pandoc, and gomarkdown/markdown.
- Supports CLI and Node.js workflows, including GFM, CommonMark, and standard Markdown flavors.
- Handles basic Markdown elements, code blocks, collapsed sections, math expressions, and tables.
- Works with static site generators and templating systems such as Jekyll and Hugo.
- Provides sample conversions and references for typical Markdown-to-HTML cases.
